programme.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess With Zero Believers Ep02
programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep04
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep05
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: S2 Ep05
programme.desc: Chise comes across a particular rumor. The 'Seven Shields' and the 'Webster's Tragedy'. Meanwhile, she tries talking to her classmate Zoe, who has been acting cold and distant, but...

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: S2 Ep06
programme.desc: Frustrated by some unexpected words from her master, Alice visits the Ainsworth household. Chise learns about Alice's feelings and begins thinking about her situation.

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep05
programme.desc: Ichikawa ends up in Yamada's workplace tour group by luck. After school, Ichikawa finds Yamada and Hara having fun talking to each other while he grows curious about their conversation.

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep06
programme.desc: Ichikawa and Yamada got separated from the group on the way back from the workplace tour. Eating is no longer allowed in the library. Will Ichikawa and Yamada's alone time end here?!

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep01
programme.desc: High schooler Sakura Minamoto is hit by a truck and awakens in a mansion in Saga Prefecture. She discovers she's one of the girls Kotaro Tatsumi resurrected as zombies to be idols.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep02
programme.desc: The next day, the girls perform at Saga Castle when they nearly break their masquerade as regular humans when one of the zombies, Tae Yamada - is accidentally decapitated on stage.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep03
programme.desc: Kotaro plans for a guerrilla performance at Karatsu Station, while the girls decide on a name for their group and settling on the name 'Franchouchou' after the sound of Tae's sneezing.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep04
programme.desc: With their funds running low, Kotaro books the girls to perform for a pharmaceutical company at a hot springs resort. But taking a dip in the hot springs makes them lose the sponsorship.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep05
programme.desc: Franchouchou lands a commercial gig for a fried chicken restaurant. Later, the girls participate in series of muddy but fun-filled competition as a publicity stunt.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep06
programme.desc: Franchouchou has their first ever fan event, but Ai and Junko have different opinions on how idols should interact with their fans. Junko contemplates leaving Franchouchou.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep07
programme.desc: Junko refuses to participate in the Saga Rock Festival, as Ai struggles with learning two solos and overcoming the trauma from her onstage death by lightning.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep08
programme.desc: Franchouchou's popularity is on the rise after their Saga Rock breakout performance. Recognising Lily as his child, Takeo Go attends their next fan event.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep09
programme.desc: Saki bumps into the current members of her old biker girl gang. When she finds out that the current leader is challenged by a rival gang to a race, Saki takes her place instead.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep10
programme.desc: With the concert at Arpino approaching, the group trains in the mountains. A week before the concert, Sakura gets hit by a truck, causing her memories to revert to when she was alive.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep11
programme.desc: Sakura regains her memories, but forgotten her life as a zombie. She believes she doesn't have what it takes to be an idol and quits the group. Kotaro is determined not to give up on her.

programme.title: Zombie Land Saga Ep12
programme.desc: The girls' refuse to take Sakura's no for an answer, and convinces her to rejoin. Despite the heavy snowfall on the concert day, the group gives a successful performance.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD Ep09
programme.desc: Knowing that all the rumors are conntected, Iroha decides to reply the mysterious thread of messages she has been receiving. The sender invites Iroha to the Loner's Horizon.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD Ep10
programme.desc: Ai chose to erase herself to set Sana free. The destruction of the Loner's Horizon throws Alina into a rage while she starts attacking Iroha and the girls relentlessly.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep03
programme.desc: Sariphi learns that Leonhart hasn't taken a break for a long time. Leonhart agrees to take a trip outside the palace together but with a condition.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep04
programme.desc: To appease the nobles who object to Sariphi's appearance, Anubis invited demon princesses for talks of marriage with Leonhart. Leonhart refuses, but Sariphi convinces him to meet them.

programme.title: Secrets of the Silent Witch Ep09
programme.desc: Monica thwarts the assassination attempt on Felix. Louis tries to take the culprit away, but she stops him. Felix learns that the Silent Witch prevented the assassination attempt.

programme.title: Secrets of the Silent Witch Ep10
programme.desc: Monica is to represent Serendia in a chess tournament against two elite schools. Learning that Minerva Mage Institution is one of the schools, Monica recalls a memory of her friend.

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep03
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep04
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?
